adamrk opened PR #15372 from adamrk:abk/windows-fs/back51 to bytecodealliance:release-51.0.0:

This commit is a behavioral adjustment for the implementation of WASI on Windows to disallow the : character from being anywhere within paths provided by the guest. The purpose of this change is to fix a bug in Wasmtime where the path ./C:foo was misinterpreted where parts of Wasmtime would see C:foo as a normal path component and other parts would see it as a drive-relative path which would possible move outside of the sandbox. Windows already disallows colons in file names anyway and blanket disallowing them additionally removes the ability to deal with an apparent feature of NTFS which uses colons to put data in separately named streams on disk.
